title: verified_chunks
description: Local Verifier (Phase B) deliverable. A flat list of fetched-and-verified source chunks, one per (url, content_hash). Handed back to the cloud Compiler. See docs/ADR/006-open-discovery-pipeline.md.

artifact_id.description: which of the 30 (or pilot) items this belongs to

source_class.description: A museum-first-party / B overseas-OA / C academic / D field-and-media / E digital-humanities

url.description: MANDATORY. A chunk with no url is rejected (anti-hallucination).

content_hash.description: sha256 of the raw fetched bytes. Required for confidence_tier=high.

license_observed.description: what the page/record actually states. unknown defaults to low tier.

confidence_tier.description: high=full quote/text allowed (needs hash + permissive license); mid=≤100-char quote + metadata; low=url+title only

excerpt_or_metadata.description: inline preview, capped (full text lives in raw_path)

raw_path.description: repo-relative path to raw evidence under data/raw/ (gitignored, local-only)

failure_reason.description: when fetch_status=failed: http_403 / http_404 / timeout / needs_login_or_paywall / ...

_hard_rules_enforced_downstream: fetch_status=ok but no content_hash -> auto-downgraded to tier=low
license_observed=unknown -> may not be embedded as full text; tier capped at low
Compiler must NOT synthesize a chunk that has no verified source here
